title: A Weekend in London
subtitle: Laboratorio: repaso para el examen A2 hasta «A Day in London»

content.instructions: Escribe la palabra que falta. Si hay una palabra entre paréntesis, úsala en la forma correcta.

items.text: Last Saturday Lucía, Priya and Daniel ___ (take) the train to London. They ___ (get up) at six, so they ___ (be) very sleepy. While the train ___ (go) through the countryside, Daniel ___ (fall) asleep.
items.hint: Take → took, fall → fell. While + past continuous.

items.text: ___, they visited Buckingham Palace. Then they walked ___ the bridge and ___ the park. "It's the ___ (big) house I ___ (ever / see)!" Lucía said. After the long walk Priya was very ___ (tire).
items.hint: Across: de un lado a otro; through: por dentro. Big → biggest.

items.text: In Camden, Lucía ___ (try / it / on) a vintage jacket, but she ___ (not / buy) it. It was ___ (expensive) than her new coat. Daniel ___ (find out) that the market closed at six.
items.explanation: Try on es separable: el pronombre va en medio (tried it on).

items.text: "London is amazing, ___ it?" Daniel said. "___ (you / ever / be) here before, Priya?" "No, I ___ (never / visit) London. But I've ___ seen the London Eye from the train!"
items.hint: Question tag: afirmativa → tag negativa. Experiencias: present perfect con ever / never.

items.text: "What ___ (we / do) tonight?" Lucía asked. "We ___ (go) to a musical at eight. I've got the tickets!" Daniel said. "Great! I ___ (buy) some snacks," Priya said. "Shall ___ get a taxi?" "No, let's walk. But take an umbrella: it ___ rain later."
items.hint: Planes con hora y entradas: present continuous. Decisión en el momento: will. Posibilidad: might.

items.text: On Sunday night Sam ___ (ask), "___ (you / enjoy) the trip?" "Yes! The musical was ___ (excite), but we ___ (spend) too much money," Lucía ___ (say). "Next time we ___ (probably / take) the bus. It's ___ (cheap) than the train."
items.hint: -ing describe la cosa (exciting); -ed, cómo te sientes. Will probably: probably va detrás de will.

vocabulary.definition: old, but good quality and fashionable
